newsitem.title: CANADA: RTRS-DBRS confirms Molson breweries rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-DBRS confirms Molson breweries rating.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said it confirmed its rating for debentures of Molson Breweries at A (high), but reduced the trend to negative from stable.

The rating agency said on Friday it reduced the trend because of Molson's declining market share and decreasing industry volumes and the outcome of an arbitration ruling between Molson and Adolph Coors Co over the licensing of Coors products in Canada.

DBRS also said it confirmed the debentures and notes of Molson Cos Ltd at A, but reduced the trend to negative from stable. The rating agency said it also confirmed Molson Cos R-1 (low) rating for commercial paper with a stable trend.
DBRS said the reduced trend rating also reflects the uncertainty of the Coors arbitration, which could reduce eight percent volume at Molson Cos 40-percent owned Molson Breweries.
Molson Breweries is 40 percent owned by Molson Cos Ltd and partly owned by Philip Morris Cos Inc and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd of Australia.
